name: ce-settings-sync
description: Sync settings, keybindings, snippets, extensions, and Cursor chats through a GitHub Gist.
author: che-11

settings-sync.gist.description: GitHub Gist id that stores the synced settings.

settings-sync.autoDownload.description: Download files when the editor starts. Extensions are not changed.

settings-sync.autoUpload.description: Upload after a settings file or extension changes.

settings-sync.forceDownload.description: Download even when the last sync times match.

settings-sync.forceUpload.description: Upload even when the Gist is unchanged or newer.

settings-sync.quietSync.description: Report the result on the status bar instead of the output channel.

settings-sync.removeExtensions.description: When downloading, offer to uninstall extensions that are not in the Gist. Nothing is removed until you confirm.

settings-sync.syncExtensions.description: Include extensions in upload and download.

settings-sync.syncChats.description: Include Cursor agent chat history in upload and download. The newest chats that fit in 8 MB are stored in the same Gist. Reload the window after a download to see them.

settings-sync.githubEnterpriseUrl.description: https URL of a GitHub Enterprise server. Leave empty for github.com.

settings-sync.downloadPublicGist.description: Allow download without a token. The Gist must be public.

settings-sync.hostName.description: Host name used by @sync host= pragmas.

settings-sync.universalKeybindings.description: Use one keybindings file on every operating system.

settings-sync.autoUploadDelay.description: Seconds to wait after a change before an automatic upload.

settings-sync.askGistDescription.description: Ask for a description when creating a Gist.

settings-sync.gistDescription.default: Visual Studio Code Settings Sync Gist
settings-sync.gistDescription.description: Description used when creating a Gist.
